items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: I listened to Howard. I never listened to the other band. I've just been there, paying attention, because I already heard them on records

ctx.x: I didn't ask you anything about Dixieland Hall yet.

Yeah, I've been there a few times. I listened to Howard. I never listened to the other band. I've just been there, paying attention, because I already heard them on records and it sounds bad enough not to be worse to go in there.
